description: This file defines the EntityLinkSuggestionsController class in Drupal, responsible for generating autocomplete suggestions for entity links, including access checks, suggestion generation, and description formatting.

classes.name: EntityLinkSuggestionsController
classes.description: Controller class for providing entity link suggestions in Drupal, including methods for access control, suggestion retrieval, and entity description formatting.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies for plugin management, entity info, repository, and date formatting.

methods.name: formatUsesEntityLinksFilter
methods.description: Checks if the editor's filter format uses the 'entity_links' filter, returning an access result.

methods.name: suggestions
methods.description: Generates JSON autocomplete suggestions based on user input and entity type info.

methods.name: getSuggestions
methods.description: Retrieves entity suggestions matching the input string for a specific entity type and language.

methods.name: createSuggestion
methods.description: Creates a suggestion array from an entity, including description, type, UUID, group, label, and URL path.

methods.name: computeDescription
methods.description: Generates a description string for an entity, including owner and creation date if available.

methods.name: computeGroup
methods.description: Determines the suggestion group based on entity type and bundle info.

methods.name: findEntityIdByUrl
methods.description: Extracts entity ID from a URL if it matches the expected pattern.
